description: Data logger for Huawei SUN2000 inverters with Modbus RTU and TCP: plant totals (power, energy, currents, voltages), power scheduling, time, alarms and device control
source: Huawei, SmartLogger ModBus Interface Definitions, Issue 35 (2020-02-20), table 2-1 SmartLogger register definitions

sources.title: SmartLogger ModBus Interface Definitions
sources.note: table 2-1; the inverter, power meter and environmental monitor tables (2-3 to 2-7) are not in this map

notes: Huawei SmartLogger. The SmartLogger's own registers (table 2-1): plant totals over all connected inverters, scheduling, system time and control. The registers of the devices behind it (inverters, meters, EMI) are not in this map.

Values are big-endian. Engineering value = register / gain (the scale here). RO registers are read with 03, RW registers are read with 03 and written with 06 or 10, WO registers are written only. Over Modbus TCP the logical device ID of the SmartLogger is 0.

registers.name: Date&Time
registers.description: Epoch seconds UTC

registers.name: Daylight Saving Time (DST)
registers.description: 0: Disabled 1: Enabled

registers.name: Time Zone
registers.description: Time zone offset measured in seconds

registers.name: DST state
registers.description: 0: DST time not entered 1: DST time entered

registers.name: The Local Time
registers.description: Epoch seconds, local time of the SmartLogger

registers.name: Power on
registers.description: The data field can only be 0 for powering on all inverters.

registers.name: Power off
registers.description: The data field can only be 0 for powering off all inverters.

registers.name: Power on/off (40202)
registers.description: 0:Power off all inverters 1:Power on all inverters

registers.name: Power on/off (40203)
registers.description: 0:Power on all inverters 1:Power off all inverters

registers.name: Transfer trip
registers.description: 0:Run 1:Fault outage The device shuts down when it stops due to faults and does not respond to the startup request.

registers.name: Array reset
registers.description: The data domain can only be 0.

registers.name: Active adjustment (40420)
registers.description: Adjusts the total active output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger. The adjustment value that is beyond the range is discarded.

registers.name: Reactive adjustment (40422)
registers.description: Adjusts the total reactive output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger. The adjustment value that is beyond the range is discarded.

registers.name: Active adjustment (40424)
registers.description: Adjusts the total active output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger.

registers.name: Reactive adjustment (40426)
registers.description: Adjusts the total reactive output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger.

registers.name: Active power adjustment by percentage
registers.description: Adjusts the total active output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger. The percentage range is 0–100%.

registers.name: Power factor adjustment
registers.description: Adjusts the total reactive output power of all inverters connected to the SmartLogger. The range is (-1,-0.8]U[0.8,1].

registers.name: DC current
registers.description: Equals the total input DC current of all inverters. If the value exceeds the range specified by I16, register 40554 is recommended.

registers.name: Input power
registers.description: Equals the total input power of all inverters.

registers.name: CO2 reduction (40523)
registers.description: Equals the total CO2 reduction of all inverters. If the value exceeds the range specified by U32, register 40550 is recommended.

registers.name: Active power
registers.description: Equals the total active output power of all inverters.

registers.name: Power factor
registers.description: Equals the total power factor of all inverters.

registers.name: Plant status (40543)
registers.description: Used by Qinghai 1: Unlimited power operation 2: Limited power operation 3: Idle 4: Outage (fault, maintenance etc.) 5: Communication interrupt

registers.name: Reactive power
registers.description: Equals the total reactive output power of all inverters.

registers.name: CO2 reduction (40550)
registers.description: Equals the total CO2 reduction of all inverters. This register represents a larger value range compared with register 40523.

registers.name: DC current 2
registers.description: Equals the total input DC current of all inverters. This register represents a larger value range compared with register 40500.

registers.name: E-Total
registers.description: Equals the total energy yield generated by all inverters.

registers.name: E-Daily
registers.description: Equals daily energy yield generated by all inverters.

registers.name: Plant status (40566)
registers.description: Used by Xinjiang 0: Idle 1: On-grid 2: On-grid: self derating 3: On-grid: Power limit 4: Planned outage 5: Power limit outage 6: Fault outage 7: Communication interrupt

registers.name: Plant status (40567)
registers.description: Used by Ningxia 1: On-grid 2: Outage 3: Maintenance 4: Idle

registers.name: Phase A current
registers.description: Equals the sum of phase A currents of all inverters.

registers.name: Phase B current
registers.description: Equals the sum of phase B currents of all inverters.

registers.name: Phase C current
registers.description: Equals the sum of phase C currents of all inverters.

registers.name: Max. reactive adjustment
registers.description: Equals the total maximum power of all inverters connected in parallel multiplied by 60%.

registers.name: Min. reactive adjustment
registers.description: Equals the total maximum power of all inverters connected in parallel multiplied by 60% x (–1).

registers.name: Max. active adjustment
registers.description: Equals the total maximum power of all inverters connected in parallel.

registers.name: Locked
registers.description: 0: Locked 1: Unlocked If more than one inverter is on-grid and feeding power to the grid, the status is Unlocked.

registers.name: DI status
registers.description: Bit0: DI1 – Bit7: DI8 1: Closed 0: Open Equals the status of the eight DIs of the SmartLogger.

registers.name: System reset
registers.description: Resets the SmartLogger. The data domain is not checked.

registers.name: Fast device access
registers.description: Automatically allocates and searches for devices.

registers.name: Device operation
registers.description: First 10 registers: determine the device to be operated based on the ESN. The register content is the device ESN. Last register: If the operation type is0, the inverters. If the operation type is 1, theinverter alarm is reset on the SmartLogger side.

registers.name: Device access status
registers.description: 0: Search completed 1: Search in progress 2: Search failed

registers.name: Active power control mode
registers.description: 0: No limit 1: DI active scheduling 3: Percentage fixed-value limitation(open loop) 4: Remote scheduling 6: Export Limitation(kW) 200: Remote output control 65533: Slave 65534: no scheduling

registers.name: Active power scheduling target value
registers.description: Target total active power for the SmartLogger active power scheduling

registers.name: Reactive power control mode
registers.description: 0: No output 1: DI reactive scheduling 2: Reactive power fix control 3: Power factor fix control 4: Q-U characteristic curve 5: cos(Phi)-P/Pn characteristic curve 6: Q-U hysteresis curve (CEI0-16) 7: Remote scheduling 9: Power factor closed-loop control(old policy) 10: Power factor closed-loop control 65533: Slave 65534: no scheduling

registers.name: Reactive power scheduling curve mode
registers.description: 0: indicates the power factor 1: indicates the reactive power fixed value

registers.name: Reactive power scheduling target value
registers.description: SmartLogger reactive power adjustment target value: power factor or total reactive power. The specific meaning depends on the reactive power scheduling mode. When the modeis the power factor, the gain is 1000. When the mode is the reactive powerfixed value, the gain is 10. Gain 10 for kvar, 1000 for a power factor (column "10/10" in the document).

registers.name: CO2 emission reduction coefficient
registers.description: [0, 10] Unit kg/kWh.

registers.name: Total rated capacity of grid-connected inverters
Communication status
registers.description: Status of communication between the SmartLogger and the servers of Japanese power companies: 0: Connection success 1: Connection failed

registers.name: Communication abnormal shutdown
registers.description: 0: Disable 1: Enable

registers.name: Auto start upon communicati on recovery
registers.description: 0: Disable 1: Enable

registers.name: The system time: year
registers.description: 2000–2068 (local time)

registers.name: Inspection
registers.description: 00:Start 01:Stop

registers.name: IV curve scanning
registers.description: 00:Stop 01:Start(64 Points) 02:Start(128 Points) 03:Start(256 Points)
